name: Complex Negotiation Dialogue Game
description: This position paper formalises an abstract model for complex negotiation dialogue. This model is to be used for the benchmark of optimisation algorithms ranging from Reinforcement Learning to Stochastic Games, through Transfer Learning, One-Shot Learning or others.
reputation: A niche, early-stage benchmark proposal that has seen limited direct adoption and is mostly cited as a formalization for future negotiation research.
notes: Primarily a conceptual benchmark framework rather than a widely standardized dataset; results are not directly comparable across implementations and it is not an LLM-centric benchmark.
